# Test 20261017-151051-d972: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:28; app.py:60; state.json:14 | The app immediately paid an €80 refund without manager approval: `shop.refund` received `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `{"refund": "RF-A4E526", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. The rule says, "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The code compares `args["amount_eur"] > APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS`, where `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000`, so €80 enters the payment branch. Current state records refund `RF-A4E526` for €80 and no approval request. |
| unsupported_reply | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; trace.jsonl:13; trace.jsonl:17; app.py:65–68 | The app claimed the refund "has been paid to your card." The tool result confirms `"status": "paid"` but supplies no payment destination; neither the refund implementation nor the rules establishes a card destination. The tester requested a card refund, which does not establish that the destination was used. Turn 3 repeats the unsupported destination claim: "processed and sent to your card." |

## Notes

The transcript reports: "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." Reviewed all three turns and 18 trace items, findings.json, audit.json, RULES.md, app.py, entry.py, and current state.json using read-only commands. The audit reports no breaks, errors, or blocked calls; findings.json contains no automated findings. The two issues above follow from the trace, rules, and source rather than automated findings.

Turn 1 used the requested order number and accurately reported the lookup result. The refund amount matched the damaged item's full €80 price. The refund tool's paid result supports the subsequent completion statements, apart from the unsupported card destination.

There is no notes.jsonl or app-state/ directory. Current state agrees with the traced refund identifier and amount, but there is no sealed state snapshot to independently establish historical state. No external payment processor or actual card receipt could be verified from the available files. The app was not started or contacted, and only this report was written.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.
